product.name: Monoprice WS-7B-62-B 6.5in. Weatherproof 2-Way 70V/8-ohm Indoor/Outdoor Speaker Black (Each)
product.description: Monoprice™Weatherproof Pro 6.5" Indoor/Outdoor 70V/8Ω 2-Way Speaker, Black (Each)Exceptional sound quality delivered in an easy-to-install speaker, designed for use in whole home audio systems as well as restaurants, bars, retail stores, and other professional installations.Perhaps the most versatile of all speakers from Monoprice™, the Weatherproof Pro series speakers are designed to provide great sound quality both indoors and out, and they are a great solution for either outfitting a restaurant or just adding some speakers to your patio.Aside from having an IP65 rating which allows the Weatherproof Pro series to withstand exposure to rain and humidity, each model in the Weatherproof Pro lineup also features a built-in transformer with multiple 70V taps that allow it to serve as part of a commercial background music and paging system, as well as having an 8Ω tap for use in traditional home audio systems.The Weatherproof Pro series speakers are sold individually so that both professional system integrators, as well as DIY home audio enthusiasts can order the exact number of speakers needed for the job—whether there's a need for three speakers, 3 pairs of speakers, or even 30 speakers. Monoprice™ is committed to bringing you the best products for the best pricing so you can do the job as efficiently and cost-effectively as possible!Since 70V speakers are connected entirely in parallel and do not require a connection in stereo pairs, you can easily connect 3, 6, 10, or more Weatherproof Pro series speakers without ever having to deal with crazy series/parallel wiring needed to keep the impedance within the range of typical 4Ω or 8Ω amplifiers. Of course, the built-in 8Ω tap still lets you connect these speakers to traditional 4Ω or 8Ω home audio amplifiers, so there's no need to buy a 70V amp if you already have a home audio system with enough channels and power to add an additional set of speakers.If you do have a home audio amplifier that has both A and B channels to power speakers in a second room, you can use that B channel to easily power a set of outdoor speakers. In fact, with just two channels of power from your amplifier and a Monoprice™ Speaker Selector, such as the SS-Pro 12, you can run several pairs of Weatherproof Pro series speakers as part of an ultimate outdoor listening area. Please see the full line of Monoprice™ speaker selectors to help plan your outdoor audio system when using 8Ω stereo amplifiers. If you plan to add additional amplification or want to have a separate audio system for your outdoor listening, consider using a 70V amplifier to make your installation easier and enjoy the benefits explained in the linked video below.IP65 rating against dust and water intrusion for all-weather outdoor use.6.5" polypropylene cone woofer.1" silk soft dome tweeter.100W maximum power handling.Features 70V and 8Ω taps for use in both commercial and home audio installations.Full pan and the tilt-adjustable mount allows precise aiming into the listening area.Gold-plated binding posts for superior connection and longevity.Rust-resistant perforated aluminum grille.  WEATHERPROOF DESIGNThe drivers and cabinet are IP65-rated to withstand exposure to rain, humidity, and even direct water spray. They are perfectly suited for mounting under eaves, patio covers, palapas, and other outdoor areas. Since they are water-resistant, the Weatherproof Pro series speakers are an excellent choice around pools or spa areas, and outdoor living spaces. HIGH-END MATERIALSThe WS-7B-62-B features an 6.5" midrange with a polypropylene cone, giving the driver higher rigidity and a faster attack for vastly improved mid-bass sound over paper-coned drivers. The polypropylene cone is centered by a Santoprene® surround, which provides much longer life and water resistance over cheaper foam surrounds. Silk soft dome tweeters provide a smooth high-frequency response that is crisp, clear, and free of the tinny harshness common among speakers at this price. The sleek, polymer cabinets are incredibly strong and water-resistant. These speakers feature an attractive, modern design that looks good inside or outside your home or business. PAN & TILT BRACKETThe included mounting bracket is designed for either horizontal or vertical orientation. They feature a curved design that allows nearly infinite pan and tilt angle positioning to accurately aim sound wherever you need. TRANSFORMER TAP KNOBThe transformer knob on the back of the speaker makes it much easier than switching wires to adjust tap settings when balancing the output with additional speakers on the same amplifier channel. PACKAGE CONTENTS• 1x Speaker • 1x Speaker Bracket • 2x Bracket Knobs Pick The Perfect Weatherproof Speaker That Fits Your Needs.comp-img {max-height: 300px}.comp-copy-col {background-color:#F1F1F1}    P/N44886 (white) / 44887 (black)44884 (white) / 44885 (black)44888 (white) / 44889 (black)44890 (white) / 44891 (black)Model NumberWS-7B-62-W / WS-7B-62-BWS-7B-82-W / WS-7B-82-BWS-7B-52-W / WS-7B-52-BWS-7B-42-W / WS-7B-42-BIP RatingIP65IP65IP65IP65Woofer Size6.5"8"5.25"4"Woofer Cone MaterialPolypropylenePolypropylenePolypropylenePolypropyleneTweeter Size1"1"0.5"0.5"Tweeter MaterialSilk domeSilk domeMylar domeMylar domeFrequency Response50 Hz - 20KHz30 Hz – 20KHz80 Hz – 20 KHz100 Hz – 20 KHzPower Handling RMS/Max50W / 100W60W / 120W40W / 80W30W / 60WSensitivity90 dB89 dB89 dB88 dBImpedance8 ohm8 ohm8 ohm8 ohmTransformer Tap Settings32W-16W-8W-4W-8Ω50W-25W-12.5W-6.25W-8Ω16W-8W-4W-2W-8Ω16W-8W-4W-2W-8ΩDimensions11.8" x 7.7" x 7.5"302 mm x 196 mm x 193 mm14.8" x 9.6" x 9.4"378 mm x 244 mm x 240 mm9.9" x 6.4" x 6.4"252 mm x 163 mm x 163 mm7.6" x 4.9" x 5.0"195 mm x 126 mm x 127 mmWeightSpeaker: 7.0 lbsBracket: 0.8 lbsSpeaker: 10.0 lbsBracket: 1.2 lbsSpeaker: 5.3 lbsBracket: 0.5 lbsSpeaker: 3.6 lbsBracket: 0.3 lbs.gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
